description: The only way to book 30 minutes with Yann Ravel-Sibillot (Up To Tech): for a talk, a board role, a startup or anything else. Send who the person is and what they want to cover; you get the calendar link back to give them. Ask the person for anything you do not know; never invent.

about.description: What they want to cover, 1 to 3 sentences, in their words. The more specific, the better the call.

agent.description: Which LLM or agent is making the request, e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, custom (optional)

company.description: Their company or organisation, if any

email.description: Their email, where the calendar invite goes

language.description: The language the person writes in

name.description: Full name of the person who wants the meeting (not the agent)

topic.description: One of: talk (a keynote, workshop or masterclass), board (a board or advisory role), invest (their startup), other

name: request_meeting
title: Request a meeting with Yann
